## `App`

struct in `choscorui::prelude::App`

```rust
pub struct App { /* private fields */ }
```

A view-based application. All windows share one reactive runtime, so
state made with [`App::runtime`](#appruntime) reaches every window.

#### Examples

```rust
use choscorui::prelude::*;

struct Counter;

impl View for Counter {
    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let count = cx.state(0);
        VStack::new((
            Text::new(move || format!("Count: {}", count.get())),
            Button::new("Increment", move || count.update(|n| *n += 1)),
        ))
        .spacing(Space::S4)
        .padding(Space::S6)
    }
}

fn main() -> Result<(), choscorui::AppError> {
    App::new()
        .window(WindowOptions::new("Counter", 400.0, 300.0), || Counter)
        .run()
}
```

### Methods

#### `App::commands`

```rust
pub fn commands(self, menu: impl Fn() -> Result<MenuBarModel, MenuError> + 'static, handler: impl Fn(&mut AppContext, MenuCommandId) + 'static) -> Self
```

Installs the menu bar that `menu` makes, and calls `handler` with
each command that the user chooses. When state that `menu` read
changes, the menu bar is made again, for example for check marks
or another language.

##### Examples

```rust
const QUIT: MenuCommandId = MenuCommandId(1);
let app = App::new().commands(
    || MenuBarModel::new(vec![MenuSpec::new("File", vec![
        MenuEntry::command(QUIT, MenuItemState::new("Quit")),
    ])]),
    |cx, command| {
        if command == QUIT {
            cx.quit();
        }
    },
);
```

#### `App::on_error`

```rust
pub fn on_error(self, handler: impl Fn(WindowId, &ViewError) + 'static) -> Self
```

Calls `handler` with each error that a window's views report. By
default the errors go to standard error.

##### Examples

```rust
});
```

#### `App::on_tick`

```rust
pub fn on_tick(self, tick: impl Fn(&mut AppContext) + 'static) -> Self
```

Calls `tick` once each turn of the event loop, after input and
before drawing.

##### Examples

```rust
let app = App::new().on_tick(|cx| {
    if cx.windows().is_empty() {
        cx.quit();
    }
});
```

#### `App::runtime`

```rust
pub fn runtime(&self) -> &Runtime
```

The reactive runtime that every window's state uses.

##### Examples

```rust
let app = App::new();
// One state for all windows.
let signed_in = app.runtime().property(false);
let app = app.window(WindowOptions::new("Home", 400.0, 300.0), move || {
    let signed_in = signed_in.clone();
    Text::new(move || if signed_in.get() { "Welcome" } else { "Sign in" })
});
```

#### `App::start`

```rust
pub fn start(self) -> Result<AppContext, AppError>
```

Starts the platform, opens the windows, and installs the menu bar.
Drive the result with [`AppContext::pump`](#appcontextpump).

##### Examples

```rust
fn main() -> Result<(), choscorui::AppError> {
    let mut cx = App::new()
        .window(WindowOptions::new("Hello", 320.0, 200.0), || Text::new("Hello"))
        .start()?;
    while cx.pump() {}
    Ok(())
}
```

## `ViewError`

enum in `choscorui::prelude::ViewError`

```rust
pub enum ViewError {
    Tree(TreeError),
    Layout(EngineError),
    Theme(ThemeError),
    Semantics(SemanticError),
    Reactive(ReactiveError),
    DuplicateKey(String),
    Control(String),
    NoToaster,
    Clamped(String),
}
```

What can go wrong while the runtime updates a view tree.

### Variants

- `Tree(TreeError)`
- `Layout(EngineError)`
- `Theme(ThemeError)`
- `Semantics(SemanticError)`
- `Reactive(ReactiveError)`
- `DuplicateKey(String)`: Two items of a `ForEach` have the same key; the later one is left
  out.
- `Control(String)`: A control view could not build its control, with the reason.
- `NoToaster`: A `.toast` modifier has no `.toaster` above it.
- `Clamped(String)`: A view option or value was invalid, and the view used the nearest
  valid value instead, with the reason.
